renderings.kjv: For I am become like a bottle

elsewhere.note: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wine skins,
He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.
Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, and a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
